description.ja: 龍 神 丸 の 魂 を 受 け 継 ぐ 新 た な 魔 神、Ｈ Ｇ に 降 臨 ！
description.en: A new demon who inherits the soul of Ryujinmaru has descended on HG!

description.ja: 『魔神英雄伝ワタル2』より、魔神 龍星丸が新規造形でＨＧシリーズから商品化。
description.en: From "Mashin Hero Wataru 2", Majin Ryuuseimaru has been commercialized from the HG series with a new model.

description.ja: 特徴的な飛龍形態への変形も、各所ギミックと一部パーツの組み換えで再現。
description.en: The transformation into the characteristic flying dragon form is also reproduced through gimmicks and rearrangement of some parts.

description.ja: 関節には引き出し式機構を搭載しボリューム感のある造形ながら剣の両手持ちが可能。
description.en: The joints are equipped with pull-out mechanisms, making it possible to hold the sword with both hands while creating a voluminous shape.

description.ja: 付属する光龍剣の宝玉はジュエルシールを採用。飛龍形態時のディスプレイを可能にする台座が付属。
description.en: The included Koryuken jewel uses a jewel seal. A pedestal is included to enable display in Hiryu form.

description.ja: ●　金色の魔神 龍星丸を新規造形でＨＧシリーズから商品化。
description.en: ● Golden Genie Ryuseimaru is commercialized from the HG series with a new model.

description.ja: 龍星丸の特徴的なフォルムを新規造形でＨＧシリーズから商品化、肩部の色分けは成形色によりパーツ分割で再現。
description.en: The distinctive form of Ryuseimaru has been commercialized from the HG series with new modeling, and the color coding of the shoulders is reproduced by dividing the parts depending on the molding color.

description.ja: 金色部分にはゴールドの成形色を採用し神々しさを演出。
description.en: The golden part uses gold molding color to create a divine look.

description.ja: ●　龍星丸の真の姿「飛龍」への変形を再現
description.en: ● Reproduce the transformation of Ryuseimaru into its true form "Hiryu"

description.ja: 龍星丸の真の姿である「飛龍」への変形ギミックを搭載。各所ギミックと一部パーツの組み換えで再現。
description.en: Equipped with a gimmick that transforms Ryuseimaru into his true form "Hiryu". Reproduced with gimmicks and rearrangement of some parts.

description.ja: 付属のディスプレイ台座により、飛龍形態のディスプレイが可能。
description.en: The included display pedestal allows for display in Hiryu form.

description.ja: ●　「光龍剣」が付属！
description.en: ● "Koryuken" is included!

description.ja: 宝玉部分にジュエルシールを採用。左右武器持ち手、左右平手が付属。
description.en: Jewel Seal is used for the jewel part. Left and right weapon holders and left and right palms are included.

description.ja: ●　引き出し式ギミックで両手持ちが可能！
description.en: ● Can be held with both hands with pull-out gimmick!

description.ja: 肩部には引き出し式の可動機構を搭載。胴体側の前後スイング機構も搭載しており「光龍剣」を両手持ちすることが可能。
description.en: Equipped with a pull-out movable mechanism on the shoulder. It is also equipped with a back and forth swing mechanism on the torso side, allowing it to hold the "Koryuken" with both hands.

description.ja: ●フルカラーパッケージでお届け！
description.en: ●Delivered in full color package!
